description.value: Gain one Ironsight class feat of 6th level or lower — the general options Hot Load and Trick Reload, plus any 2nd-, 4th- or 6th-level feat of the Draw you named with Chosen Draw. You may take this feat more than once, choosing a different feat each time.

cinderfall.incomplete: The filter is 'any Ironsight class feat of 6th level or lower' -- matching the real Basic Fury/Advanced Fury archetype-feat precedent, which likewise filters only by class trait and level and does not mechanically enforce narrower text restrictions (Hot Load/Trick Reload only, or Draw-restricted feats gated on Chosen Draw). Those narrower restrictions are unenforced here exactly as they are unenforced in the real feats they're modeled on.
